status.current_name: Arab Company for Gelatin and Pharmaceutical Products
status.owner: ACDIMA (Arab Company for Drug Industries and Medical Appliances)
status.scope_reason: The company specializes in manufacturing and supplying empty hard gelatin capsule shells under its Arab-Caps brand.
status.evidence: The company's official website confirms it manufactures empty hard gelatin capsules from its facility in Alexandria, Egypt, as an affiliate of the ACDIMA Group.

claims.claim: The company reports that its production lines utilize primary raw material animal bone gelatin with a bloom value of 245–265 to manufacture FDA-approved multi-color hard gelatin capsules, as published on the official Arab-Caps capability profile.

The company reports providing empty hard gelatin capsules equipped with Snap and Coin bar closure technology, manufactured across ten production lines with dimensions covering sizes from 00 elongated to 4, filled joined lengths from 13.9 to 25.3 mm, empty weights from 41 to 130 mg, and volume capacities from 210 to 1020 mg, according to its official capability statements.

According to Egyptian drug price final lists published in 2017 via Issuu, Arab Company for Gelatin and Pharmaceutical Products (Arab-Caps) manufactures Azgovanc 20 mg immediate-release hard gelatin capsules.
claims.corrected: According to Egyptian drug price final lists published in 2017 via Issuu, Advanced Pharmaceutical Industries Co. (apic) manufactures Azgovanc 20 mg immediate-release hard gelatin capsules.

claims.claim: The company reports running an production facility in El-Nasereya, El-Amreya, Alexandria, which underwent a major utility and facility re-engineering process starting in 2010 with an investment exceeding 30,000,000 L.E.

The company reports implementing a Quality Management System that complies with the international standards ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, OHSAS 18001:2007, and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements, as published on the official Arab-Caps Quality Policy webpage.

Personnel records from the company's Quality Control department indicate the execution of strategic plans for the verification of compendial methods against global pharmacopeial standards including the United States Pharmacopeia (USP) and European Pharmacopoeia (EP).
claims.note: strategic plans for the verification of compendial methods against global pharmacopeial standards (USP and EP) by QC personnel records

claims.claim: The company reports implementing a facility-wide re-engineering and utilities modernization process beginning in 2010 with a capital investment exceeding 30,000,000 L.E., as stated on the official Arab Company for Gelatin and Pharmaceutical Products (Arab Caps) website.

The company reports operating its primary production facility in El-Nasereya, El-Amreya, Alexandria, Egypt, which features 10 production lines and initiated a facility and utility re-engineering project in 2010 exceeding an investment of 30,000,000 L.E.

The company operates 10 production lines at its manufacturing facility in El-Nasereya, El-Amreya, Alexandria, Egypt, which produce an annual capacity ranging between 244 million and 755 million capsules per size across sizes 00 elongated to 4, as reported on the official Arab-Caps website.

The company reports annual sales of 230 million EGP across its portfolio of 25 products spanning solid and soft capsules as well as veterinary drugs, according to corporate documentation from its parent organization, the ACDIMA Group.

The company reports a collaboration agreement with Top Pharma Marketing to execute marketing activities for its gelatin-based product portfolio and establish a 5-year strategic plan within the Egyptian pharmaceutical market, as disclosed in a 2026 organizational meeting update.
claims.note: collaboration agreement with Top Pharma Marketing, 5-year strategic plan, 2026 organizational meeting update
